events.title: openai/codex 0.163.0
events.summaryText: ## New Features - Open `/config` to search preferences across categories, change supported settings immediately, and see which changes require a restart. (#52990, #53429) - Send a follow-up while Codex is responding to steer it immediately. Interrupting a turn also stops active Code Mode cells and their nested tool calls. (#51812, #51835) - Configure a leader key in `/keymap`. The default is `Ctrl+X`, shortcut hints stay open until you choose or cancel, and voice mute moves to `F9`. (#52273) ...
